ExposureDiagnostics.description:
Diagnostics from exposure simulation capturing data quality metrics.

Populated by the exposure computation engine to let callers distinguish
genuine zero exposure from missing data.

market_roll_failures.description: Number of time grid points where market data could not be rolled forward.

valuation_failures.description: Total number of individual instrument valuation failures across all time points.

description: Exposure profile computed at each time grid point.

diagnostics.description: Simulation quality diagnostics (populated by the exposure engine).

ene.description: Expected Negative Exposure at each time point: max(-V(t), 0).

epe.description: Expected Positive Exposure at each time point: max(V(t), 0).

mtm_values.description: Portfolio mark-to-market value at each time point (may be negative).

times.description:
Nonnegative time points in years from valuation date. An explicit zero
node supplies opening exposure; before the first node exposure is held
flat at that node, consistently across CVA, DVA, FVA and MVA.

title: ExposureProfile
